text: dsh-memvault 是 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。它把本机 MemVault 核心记忆块作为动态上下文加入 system prompt，并把完成的对话回合整理后写入同一 SQLite 记忆库。用户可通过 memory_search 检索记忆、memory_add 手动保存事实，也可在网页面板浏览和编辑记忆、查看来源与抽取状态。适合希望在不同会话中延续用户或 agent 记忆的 DSH 使用场景；配置 OpenAI-compatible 服务可进行模型抽取与向量嵌入，无密钥时使用规则抽取和本地嵌入。

dsh-memvault adds long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness by injecting local memory blocks into the system prompt and extracting completed turns into SQLite. The model can search or add memories with tools; a web panel supports browsing and editing. OpenAI-compatible extraction is optional.
想让 DSH 每次回答前都能看到用户的长期记忆
怎么把已经结束的对话整理成以后能找回的记忆？
需要一个能按关键词或语义找回旧事实的记忆工具
想手动补充一条自动整理可能遗漏的长期信息
在网页里查看、修改和追踪保存过的记忆
希望记忆存放在本机 SQLite，而不是每次都重新输入
Let DSH keep user- and agent-scoped memories separate and searchable.
Keep long-term facts available in the DSH system prompt across turns.
dsh-memvault 的功能「记忆上下文注入」：每次构建 system prompt 时读取并格式化核心记忆块，作为动态上下文贡献提供给 DSH。
dsh-memvault 的功能「回合自动抽取」：会话结束回合事件达到配置条件后进入窗口，再由管线抽取并保存记忆。
dsh-memvault 的功能「记忆检索与补充」：模型调用 memory_search 查询长期记忆，也可用 memory_add 按指定作用域手动保存事实。
dsh-memvault 的功能「记忆管理面板」：通过网页面板浏览记忆、刷新状态并查看记忆来源；启用写入时还能编辑核心块。
dsh-memvault 使用前须知：配置 OpenAI-compatible API 后，自动抽取或嵌入会使用该服务；未配置密钥时回退到规则抽取和本地嵌入。

dsh-memvault README · dsh-memvault：MCP is pull-only, so "memory is already loaded" can never come from a server. This plugin does it inside DSH — and since 0.9.x it owns the store too: no Python, no second process.

dsh-memvault README · dsh-memvault：| Half | What | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Inject** | core blocks in the system prompt, every step | `ctx.systemPrompt.context()` |
| **Extract** | finished turns → one window → one LLM pass | `session/event` → window → `add`/`supersede`/`none` |
| **Recall** | `memory_search` / `memory_add` | FTS5 trigram + vectors, RRF, answerability guard |
| **Show** | overview / memories / structure, block editing, replay | host routes + conversation tab / settings page |

dsh-memvault README · ✨ Features：| | |
|---|---|
| 🗄️ **One store** | prompt, extraction, tools and panel read `~/.dsh/memvault/memvault.db` |
| 🧠 **No tool call needed** | blocks ride the runtime context, TTL-cached |
| ⏱️ **Off the critical path** | queued windows, one call per `N` turns / idle / cap |
| 🔎 **Hybrid recall** | substring truth (trigram) + paraphrase (vectors), fused |
| 🛠️ **Two tools** | scoped by `user_id` / `agent_id` / `run_id` |
| 🎛️ **A real panel** | diagnostics, vector backfill, provenance, relation graph |
| 🪶 **Zero deps** | `node:sqlite` + hand-written client bundle |

dsh-memvault README · 🚀 Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-memvault
```

Self-owned install links a checkout in the profile's `package.json` (`dsh-memvault: link:…`) plus a junction under `node_modules` — see `docs/DEVLOG.md`. A new bundle needs a **DSH restart**; after editing the client run `npm run build`.

dsh-memvault README · ⚙️ Configuration：| Field | Default |
|---|---|
| `scopes` | `[{user,lenovo},{agent,claude-code-memory}]` |
| `labels` / `maxChars` / `refreshMs` | `[]` / `4000` / `30000` |
| `extract.everyNTurns` / `idleMs` / `windowTurns` | `3` / `20000` / `8` |
| `extract.minTranscriptChars` / `maxInputChars` | `40` / `6000` |
| `extract.projectDir` / `env` | checkout path / `{}` (where `.env` is read) |
| `panel.writes` | `true` |

dsh-memvault README · ⚙️ Configuration：`dbPath` and `extract.pythonPath` are accepted but unused. The pipeline reads the usual `.env` keys (`OPENAI_*`, `MEMVAULT_EXTRACTOR=rule|llm`, `MEMVAULT_EMBEDDER=local|openai`, `MEMVAULT_ADJUDICATOR=off`).

dsh-memvault README · 🗄️ Store & migration：`~/.dsh/memvault/memvault.db` (override `DSH_MEMVAULT_CORE_DB`). From the Python store, once:

```bash
memvault export --from data/memvault.db --out export.json
node scripts/import-core.mjs export.json ~/.dsh/memvault/memvault.db --apply
node scripts/backfill-core.mjs ~/.dsh/memvault/memvault.db --project-dir <checkout> --apply
```

flowchart LR

  S --> P[system prompt]

dsh-memvault README · 🧪 Verification：`npm test` (6 smokes + 48 unit). Live: `/memvault/api/status` shows the last five outcomes (`[rule]|[llm] ok added=N`); replay via `POST /memvault/api/replay`; recall via `memory_search`.

dsh-memvault README · 🧠 Decisions：- **One store, not two** — no "tool saw it, panel didn't".
- **Supersede, never delete** — history keeps the audit.
- **Only user text is extracted** — short windows are skipped (`docs/DEVLOG.md` §35).

dsh-memvault README · ⚠️ Limits：- Single machine, single store: no sync, no encryption.
- Extraction quality depends on the extractor (rule is deterministic but narrow; LLM depends on the endpoint).
